description:
Puts the dash and a taskbar in the top panel.

Dash: favorite and running apps, optional app grid button, adjustable icons and running indicator. Clicking the focused app minimizes it.

Tasks: one button per window. Hover to raise the window, right click for the app menu, middle click to open a new window or to close it. Optional grouping by app. Windows asking for attention turn red.

Also: workspaces bar, favorites and recent apps menus, show desktop button, user name, light style, accent or custom panel color, clock on the right, and panels on every monitor.

Every feature can be turned off in the settings; turned-off features are not loaded.

Fork of Tasks in panel by fthx.
name: Dash and Tasks in panel
